annotation.title_clean: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.title_en: Public Consultation Feedback: Proposed Artificial Intelligence (AI) Governance Bill
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National AI Office (NAIO), Ministry of Digital, Malaysia
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian National AI Office consultation page (10 Jul–1 Aug 2026) on a proposed AI Governance Bill creating central oversight, principle-based requirements and a risk-based framework. The page holds links to the consultation paper and questionnaire, plus public comments on interoperability with the EU AI Act, Sabah's constitutional position, children's protection and sandboxes. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposed Bill would establish central institutional AI oversight (Central AI Authority) with sectoral leads
Introduces principle-based national governance requirements and a risk-based regulatory framework
Defines roles and responsibilities of AI actors; includes AI sandbox and incident-reporting mechanisms
Stakeholders urge interoperability with the EU AI Act and ASEAN guides
Comments call for safeguards for Sabah/Sarawak, children and vulnerable persons, and ombudsman/parliamentary oversight
